title: Unified Token-Efficient DSL Syntax Across All Technologies
description: Unify syntax across all DSLs in the repo (dsl/ engine, mathematical/graph/dsl wire+Jack, vcs .ops header, trinity/ram legacy lexer, ~55 adopter crates). Target: maximum token/parser efficiency (schema stated once via SoA tables, implicit-preferred, bare strings), domain-intuitive syntax subsetting existing languages (SVG paths, Cypher), streaming/lazy-loadable layout (metadata first, statement-level incremental parse), and one consistent sigil set repo-wide: `:` typing, lowercase-kebab names, PascalCase domain kinds / UPPERCASE schema type tags, `--`/`->`/`<-` connections, `@` connection points, `_` placeholders, bare-preferred `""` strings. Compose's C# expression language is explicitly deferred to a follow-up ticket. Full design in /Users/ueli/.claude/plans/every-dsl-must-be-crispy-shell.md — Wave 0 engine (dsl/core, dsl/schema, dsl/derive, dsl facade, delete dsl/codec), Wave 1 choke points (vcs .ops, mathematical/graph/dsl wire+Jack), Wave 2 parallel adopter packages (P1-P10 covering all fixture-bearing crates), Wave 3 convergence gate (delete serde_json::Value DocumentDsl bridge, full verify).
summary:
Completed the fast-follow flagged in Wave 2/3 (scratch/wave2-p10-sweep-status.md finding #1, wave3-final-status.md §5.1): migrated the last remaining "nodeId:portId" edge-endpoint string convention to the unified "nodeId@portId" syntax across the whole node-graph/DAG ecosystem, atomically.

Original scope named 3 sites; investigation found the convention duplicated across 6 more crates that each independently bridge to the generic node-graph JSON wire format (dag/plugin, trinity/plugin, s/plugin, sequence/plugin+core, flow/plugin+core, procedural/plugin's app_2d+app_3d modules, neural/dag, puzzle/plugin, plus the TS/React renderer and the mathematical/graph/dsl JS twin). Reference implementation mirrored: trinity_ram::parse_port_key/port_key (@ split, empty-segment rejection).

Along the way found and fixed two genuine pre-existing bugs unrelated to the : -> @ swap itself, in the same wiring:
- trinity/plugin/rs "deleteSelection" handler (rewrite play surface) hardcoded split(':') against edges that the rest of the crate had already migrated to '@' in an earlier wave — silently broke edge deletion for any node whose id happened to contain ':'. Fixed to delegate to trinity_ram::port_node_id.
- framework/renderer/react/index.tsx's SSR-fallback React Flow renderer set `<Handle id>` to the full joined MediaGraphPort.id while onConnect/edges compared against the bare split-out sourcePortId/targetPortId — a latent mismatch that predates this ticket. Added portHandleId() to derive the bare id consistently on both sides.

Explicitly left alone (different, unrelated colon conventions, verified case by case): dag/rs's 3-segment internal-only handle key (node:direction:port, never serialized); framework/product/os/core's instanceId:specId:direction OsMediaPort identity/VFS-path convention; trinity/plugin's Cypher-style pattern-var:kind syntax; resourceKind:format registry keys; dsl/schema's field:TYPE schema-printer typing syntax; mathematical_graph_dsl's rs+js legacy `:`/`.` wire-endpoint fallback parsers (deliberately multi-format, `@` now checked first).

Verification: cargo test green on all 12 touched Rust crates (dag 112, dag-plugin 11, node-graph 38, trinity-plugin 36, s-plugin 50, sequence-plugin 24, flow-plugin, procedural-plugin, sequence_core, flow_core 91, neural_dag 1, puzzle-plugin 108 — one flow_core test, hexagonal_mushroom_fixture_reports_extruded_solid_output, is pre-existing global-handle-counter flakiness under parallel execution, confirmed passing in isolation and unrelated to this change). @semio-tech/graph-dsl-core JS tests green (8/8). @semio-tech/framework-renderer-react JS tests: the 15 media-graph-scoped tests all pass; 3 unrelated pre-existing failures (plugin-worker mock timeouts, an icon-catalog name mismatch from concurrent icon work) confirmed unrelated by error content, not caused by this change.

Repo-wide grep sweep after all edits confirmed zero remaining live "nodeId:portId" edge-join sites in both Rust and TS/TSX (only archived .repo/🎫️/ ticket backups and the intentionally-preserved unrelated colon conventions remain).
